item.title: On Tape << Rewind Has Players Decoding Cassette Tapes to Solve a Cold War Mystery
item.description: On Tape << Rewind is a psychological horror story told through cassette tapes. Play recordings, search for clues, discover hidden cassettes, and manipulate audio. Unravel the mystery of a scientists disappearance and the obsession that consumed him tape by tape.
